title: Modal from trigger
sub: Dialog scales out of the button
html:
Invite your team

They get access to every project.

maya@studio.co
prompt: Build a modal that scales out of the button that opened it. On open, measure the trigger's center relative to the dialog (getBoundingClientRect with the dialog's transform temporarily cleared) and set the dialog's transform-origin to that point in px, then transition the dialog from transform: scale(.12); opacity: 0 to scale(1); opacity: 1 over 600ms using a slight-overshoot spring such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%). Dim the page with a scrim (rgba of your ink at 40 percent) that fades in over 380ms with cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Closing reverses it back into the trigger. Use the native <dialog> element with showModal() or role="dialog" aria-modal="true", close on Escape and scrim click, and lock page scroll while open. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Bottom sheet
sub: Slides up, drags down, rubber-bands at top
html:
Photos
Share with
MessageMailCopyMore
prompt: Build a draggable bottom sheet for a mobile web view. The sheet is position: absolute (or fixed on a real page) at the bottom, with a 30x4px grabber, 18px top radius and a soft upward shadow. Closed it sits at transform: translateY(104%); open it springs to translateY(0) over 620ms with cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), while a scrim fades in. Dragging: on pointerdown capture the pointer, set transition: none and set touch-action: none on the sheet; on pointermove translate by the drag distance when pulling down, and when pulling up past the open position apply a rubber band, translateY(-min(26px, pow(-d, .72))) so it resists instead of moving freely. On pointerup, close if the sheet was dragged past about 30 percent of its height or flicked fast, otherwise clear the inline transform so the CSS spring returns it to 0. Tapping the scrim closes it. Add role="dialog", move focus inside on open, and a visible close control for keyboard users. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

sub: Settings slide in, page steps back
html:

prompt: Build a right-side settings drawer. A panel 60 percent of the viewport wide (max 420px) is position: absolute or fixed to the right edge, closed at transform: translateX(104%) and open at translateX(0) over 620ms with cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), with a soft leftward shadow. At the same time push the page back: give the page wrapper transition: transform 560ms and on open set transform: translateX(-14px) scale(.93) with a slight desaturate, and fade in a scrim (ink at 40 percent) over it. Inside the drawer list setting rows separated by hairlines, each with a toggle switch (28x16 track, 12px knob that moves with translateX(12px) and a slight-overshoot spring such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%)). Close with the X button, Escape or a scrim click. Use <aside role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Settings"> and keep the page inert while open. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Toast stack
sub: Toasts stack, older ones scale back
prompt: Build a toast stack in the bottom-right corner. Each toast is a white rounded card with a tinted check chip, a title, a one-line detail and a small close button. Stack them in one fixed-size container: every toast is position: absolute; bottom: 0; right: 0 and gets a --k custom property equal to its distance from the newest (0 for the newest). Style them from --k: transform: translateY(calc(var(--k) * -9px)) scale(calc(1 - var(--k) * .06)) with transform-origin: bottom right, and opacity: calc(1 - var(--k) * .22), so older toasts peek out above and shrink behind. A new toast enters from translateY(26px) scale(.92); opacity: 0 over 520ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), and the older ones re-layout through the same transition. Dismiss by sliding right with translateX(115%) and fading, then remove the node. Cap the visible stack at three, pause auto-dismiss while the pointer hovers the stack, use role="status" aria-live="polite", and give the close buttons accessible names. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Tooltip
sub: Springs from its anchor after a delay
html: Bookmark Copy link Duplicate
prompt: Build a tooltip that springs out of its anchor. Wrap each icon button in a position: relative anchor and place the tooltip above it (bottom: calc(100% + 9px), centered) as a dark rounded label with a small rotated-square arrow (::after, 8px, rotated 45deg) pointing at the button. Hidden state: opacity 0, transform: translateY(8px) scale(.5), transform-origin: 50% 100% so it grows from the arrow tip. On :hover and :focus-visible of the anchor, show it with a 220ms hover-intent delay (transition-delay: 220ms on the show only) and a slight-overshoot spring such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%) over 600ms; hide it instantly with a short 160ms ease so moving across buttons feels snappy. Connect it with aria-describedby and role="tooltip", make Escape dismiss it, and show it on keyboard focus as well as hover. On touch devices skip hover tooltips. Animate only transform and opacity. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Popover menu
sub: Menu grows from origin, items stagger
prompt: Build a popover menu that grows from its trigger. Anchor a small card under a button (position: absolute, aligned to the button's right edge) and set transform-origin to the corner nearest the button, here 100% 0. Closed: transform: scale(.5); opacity: 0; open: scale(1); opacity: 1 over 600ms with a slight-overshoot spring such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%). The menu items stagger in after the container starts growing: each starts at opacity 0 and translateY(-6px) and settles over 300ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) with transition-delay: calc(70ms + var(--i) * 55ms), where --i is the item index; remove the delay on close so it dismisses at once. Rotate the trigger's chevron 180deg while open. Items have a leading icon and a soft accent hover fill; the destructive item hovers red. Use aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded, role="menu" and role="menuitem", arrow-key navigation, Escape to close and return focus to the trigger. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Cookie banner
sub: Slides up, Accept collapses it away
html: We use cookiesTo improve your experience on this site.
prompt: Build a cookie consent banner that slides up from the bottom of the page. A rounded white bar, inset 10px from the edges, holds a tinted cookie icon, a short title with one line of explanation, and two buttons: a quiet "Settings" and a primary "Accept". It enters with transform: translateY(130%) to none over 640ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), after a short delay on first paint. Pressing Accept gives the button a 90ms scale(.94) press, then the banner collapses away: transform: translateY(40%) scale(.85, .2) with transform-origin: 50% 100% plus opacity to 0, over about 520ms, then set hidden and remember the choice in localStorage (wrapped in try/catch) so it never reappears. Use role="region" with an accessible name, keep it out of the way of the page's primary actions, move no focus on load, and make sure both buttons are keyboard reachable. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

sub: Countdown bar runs, Undo restores the row
html:

prompt: Build an undo snackbar for a destructive-but-reversible action such as archiving an email. When the row is archived, collapse it without animating height: the row wrapper is display: grid with grid-template-rows: 1fr that transitions to 0fr, with opacity 0 and translateX(30px), over 480ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), and its inner child has overflow: hidden and min-height: 0. At the same time slide a dark snackbar up from the bottom edge (translateY(150%) to none over 560ms) reading "Message archived" with an accent "Undo" text button. Draw a 3px countdown bar along its bottom edge using transform: scaleX(1) to scaleX(0), transform-origin: left, linear, over the dismiss time (about 5 seconds on a real site). Pause the countdown while the pointer or focus is on the snackbar. Undo cancels the timer and restores the row with the reverse transition; if the timer ends, hide the snackbar and commit the action. Use role="status" so the message is announced, and make Undo reachable by keyboard (also bind it to Ctrl/Cmd+Z). Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

sub: Opens at the pointer, scales from a corner
html:

prompt: Build a custom context menu. Listen for the contextmenu event on the surface, call preventDefault(), and position a small menu absolutely at the pointer coordinates relative to its container. Before showing, measure the menu: if it would overflow the right edge, place it at x - width; if it would overflow the bottom, place it at y - height; then set transform-origin to the corner that touches the pointer (left/right and top/bottom accordingly). Closed: transform: scale(.6); opacity: 0; open: scale(1); opacity: 1 over about 380ms with a gentle overshoot such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%). Items are 11px rows with right-aligned shortcut hints, an accent fill on hover and a red destructive item. Close on outside click, Escape, scroll or window blur. Use role="menu" and role="menuitem", move focus to the first item on open, support arrow keys, and keep the browser's native menu available via Shift+right-click for accessibility. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Alert dialog
sub: Outside click gives a gentle shake
html:
Delete this project?

All files and history will be removed. This cannot be undone.
prompt: Build a destructive confirmation dialog. Dim and slightly blur the page behind it, then show a centered card with a red-tinted icon chip, a clear question ("Delete this project?"), one line of consequence, and two buttons: a neutral Cancel and a red Delete. It enters from transform: scale(.9); opacity: 0 with a critically damped spring such as linear(0, 0.094 5.6%, 0.274 11.1%, 0.455 16.7%, 0.608 22.2%, 0.726 27.8%, 0.812 33.3%, 0.873 38.9%, 0.916 44.4%, 0.944 50%, 0.976 61.1%, 1 100%) over 590ms. Because this is an alert dialog, clicking the scrim must NOT dismiss it; instead replay a gentle shake on the card: @keyframes with translateX values -7px, 6px, -4px, 3px, -1.5px, 0 over 520ms ease-in-out, restarted each time by removing the class, forcing a reflow and adding it again. Escape and Cancel close it. Use role="alertdialog" with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby, focus Cancel first (the safe choice), trap focus, and under prefers-reduced-motion replace the shake with a brief outline flash. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

prompt: Build an island-style notification: a small black pill at the top center of a phone-shaped view that expands into a rich notification and contracts back. Make one dark element at its full expanded size and morph it with clip-path rather than animating width and height: collapsed clip-path: inset(0 31% 62% 31% round 10px), expanded clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0 round 24px), transitioning over 640ms with a slight-overshoot spring such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%). Inside, the compact state shows only a small accent dot; the expanded content (avatar, sender name, message preview, "now") fades and scales in from scale(.92) with a 160-200ms delay so it appears after the shape opens, and fades out first on contraction. Auto-dismiss after about 2.5 seconds, tapping the pill toggles it, and announce the message through a role="status" live region. Under prefers-reduced-motion cross-fade between the two states instead of morphing. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Onboarding tour
sub: A spotlight hops between UI elements
html:
1 of 3Your profile

Switch accounts and manage billing here.
prompt: Build an onboarding product tour with a moving spotlight. Overlay the page with one absolutely positioned "spot" element whose box-shadow does the dimming: box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px your-accent-light, 0 0 0 999px rgba(ink, .5), with a 9px radius, so the page stays visible through a cutout. For each step, read the target's getBoundingClientRect relative to the container, add 4px padding, and move the spot with transform: translate(x, y) while its width and height ease to the target's size, 640ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). A step card follows it with its own translate: place it below the target, flip above when it would overflow, and clamp it inside the container. The card shows "1 of 3", a title, one sentence and a Next button (Done on the last step); the title and text cross-fade on each step. Re-measure on resize and scroll. Use role="dialog" with aria-describedby, move focus to Next, allow Escape to skip and arrow keys to step, and scroll the target into view before measuring. Trap and restore focus (move focus into the layer on open, return it to the trigger on close, close on Escape), set the right role and aria attributes, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transforms and keep only a short opacity fade. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.
